label: Gara Toht Lake (fishing)
note: Day or night: Charc Eel. Night only: Norg, with Norg Bait at a hotspot. Mawfish also bite here by day. Cut fish at Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus.

label: Ocean, Er-Phryah's Vigil coast (fishing)
note: Day: Tralok. Day or night: Goopolla, Sharrac (Twilight Bait) and Murkray (Murkray Bait, hotspots only). Night only: Glappid, with Glappid Bait. Cut fish at Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus.

label: Pond west of Twin Horns (fishing)
